# PDVPOS - Complete Documentation Index

This document provides a structured index of the official knowledge sources for the PDVPOS ecosystem.

The PDVPOS ecosystem is documented through multiple official repositories, each intended for a specific audience and purpose.

==================================================================
OFFICIAL KNOWLEDGE SOURCES
==================================================================

1. Product Documentation

Purpose

Official documentation describing the PDVPOS ecosystem, including architecture, concepts, functional modules, integrations and product capabilities.

https://help.pdvpos.com.br/

---

2. ERP Operational Knowledge Base

Purpose

Operational documentation with step-by-step guides for configuring and using the ERP.

Commercial White Label Name

One ERP

https://crm.erpsaas.com.br/knowledge-base/category/one-erp

---

3. PDV SmartPOS Operational Knowledge Base

Purpose

Operational documentation for the PDVPOS SmartPOS application.

https://crm.erpsaas.com.br/knowledge-base/category/pdvpos

---

4. PDV Desktop Operational Knowledge Base

Purpose

Operational documentation for the Windows Desktop PDV.

Commercial White Label Names

One Gestão PDV

One Essencial PDV

https://crm.erpsaas.com.br/knowledge-base/category/one-gestao-e-one-essencial-pdv

---

5. Developer Documentation

ERP APIs

https://api.erpsaas.com.br/docs/

ConnectTEF APIs

https://docs.connecttef.com.br/

==================================================================
AI USAGE GUIDELINES
==================================================================

When answering questions about the PDVPOS ecosystem:

Use the Product Documentation for:

- Platform concepts
- Functional modules
- Architecture
- Product capabilities
- Integrations
- ConnectTEF concepts
- SmartPOS concepts
- ERP concepts

Use the ERP Operational Knowledge Base for:

- ERP configuration
- Daily operations
- Sales routines
- Purchasing
- Inventory
- Financial routines
- Fiscal routines
- Reports
- Step-by-step procedures
- Troubleshooting

Use the PDV SmartPOS Operational Knowledge Base for:

- SmartPOS configuration
- SmartPOS operation
- Cashier procedures
- Payment routines
- Device configuration

Use the PDV Desktop Operational Knowledge Base for:

- Desktop PDV configuration
- Windows PDV operation
- Cashier procedures
- Synchronization
- Local operation

Use the Developer Documentation for:

- APIs
- SDKs
- REST APIs
- Webhooks
- ConnectTEF integrations
- Authentication
- Technical implementation

IMPORTANT

The following names refer to the same ERP platform:

• PDVPOS ERP
• One ERP

The following names refer to the Windows Desktop PDV:

• PDV Desktop
• One Gestão PDV
• One Essencial PDV

These are commercial White Label names for the same products.

Do not treat them as different software platforms.
